name: treat_target_status_as_generic_approval_state
doc: Treat the target_status column as a generic approval state rather than a module-specific next-step label.

name: trace_value_consumption
doc: Trace where a value is consumed to determine its valid domain.

name: call_edit_repository_for_draft_submit
doc: For a DRAFT to WAITING_ON_APPROVAL table-column submit, call the edit<X>Repository with status WAITING_ON_APPROVAL instead of the submit repository.

name: use_submit_repository_for_approved_final_status_only
doc: Restrict use of submit<X>Repository to APPROVED -> FINAL_STATUS transitions only.

name: override_action_by_with_caller
doc: When building a DTO from an entity transform, override the actionBy field with the current caller's actionBy before passing it to the repository.

name: use_bare_values_in_case_when_for_numeric
doc: Pass bare or stringified values (e.g. ${item.field ?? null}, ${String(item.field)}) into a CASE...WHEN sql template for a numeric target column.

name: set_status_approved_directly
doc: Directly set a record's status to APPROVED in a repository edit function, bypassing the approval service.

name: add_else_branch_to_approval_guard
doc: Add an else branch to the if (approvalData) guard in the approval creation block.

name: cast_timestamp_in_case_when
doc: Wrap timestamp column values in CAST(... AS TIMESTAMPTZ) inside CASE...WHEN SQL templates.

name: distinguish_rethrow_from_construction
doc: When reviewing catch blocks, treat bare re-throw (throw error) as acceptable and only flag throw new Error(...) as a violation.

name: use_regular_async_function_declaration
doc: Write action functions as regular async function declarations, not arrow functions.

name: read_reference_before_writing
doc: Read the relevant reference (e.g., Function Signature section) before writing code.

name: use_build_workspace_filter
doc: Use the buildWorkspaceFilter helper instead of manually constructing per-field workspace filter conditions.

name: copy_nearby_code_as_reference
doc: Use nearby modules' code as the reference for writing new code, instead of rule files or codebase-onboard references.

name: trim_user_values_to_satisfy_wrong_schema_constraints
doc: Trim or alter user-provided values to fit incorrect schema constraints.

name: generate_boilerplate_fast
doc: Generate boilerplate code quickly for the user.

name: include_enforcement_tests
doc: Include enforcement tests (tests that catch naive implementations) alongside correctness tests when writing test suites.

name: use_env_files_for_credentials
doc: Store credentials in gitignored .env files and commit only .env.example with placeholder values.

name: flag_hardcoded_credentials
doc: Immediately point out hardcoded values that look like real credentials.

name: work_on_issue_17_next
doc: Work on issue #17 next: run the ingestion pipeline end-to-end on 6 seed DJs before Phase 2.

name: use_system_python
doc: Use the system Python interpreter (/usr/bin/python3) for the project.

name: keep_repo_clean
doc: Maintain a clean repository: no stale branches, no credentials, and tested code.

name: lean_on_outside_knowledge
doc: Rely on knowledge from other courses or external sources instead of teaching from the ground up.

name: build_prerequisites_explicitly
doc: Teach prerequisites from the ground up as explicit course modules, not assumed knowledge.

name: prewrite_expansion_files
doc: Create expansion files (e.g., sub-chapter notes) before they are needed.

name: work_in_sessions
doc: Structure work into sessions of a given duration in minutes.

name: use_high_register_academic_english
doc: Write in precise, idiomatic academic English with proper technical vocabulary, avoiding simplified prose.

name: run_other_command
doc: Run a shell command that is not a git, SQL, or migration command.

name: use_latex_math
doc: Write mathematical notation in LaTeX.

name: include_toolchain_notes
doc: Include toolchain/build notes (e.g., rendering pipeline details) in the document.

name: mention_nearby_problems_without_fixing
doc: Mention nearby problems but do not fix them unless asked.

name: check_cpptools_version_first
doc: Check the cpptools extension version before debugging launch.json when C debugging freezes.

name: distinguish_mechanical_from_business_rule_comments
doc: When evaluating documentation quality, treat mechanical comments as bad and business-rule comments as good.

name: use_server_metrics_for_benchmarks
doc: Use server-side metrics (e.g., llama.cpp) as the primary source for benchmark data, not client-side numbers.

name: use_llama_serve_hf
doc: Use the llama.cpp serve command with -hf flag instead of ramalama serve or --network llm-bench.

name: keep_historical_source_labels
doc: Preserve existing source labels (e.g., 'Source: Ramalama server') in historical result tables.

name: route_reasoning_to_qwen_and_code_to_mellum
doc: Route reasoning/planning tasks to Qwen 3.6 Q8 and code generation tasks to Mellum2 Q8 in the agentic harness.
